language.name: openfeature
language.title: OpenFeature
language.description: Evaluate a feature flag as a boolean predicate
language.label: language,cloud

expressionIn.description: Not read: the expression is the flag key, and the targeting key and the context come from headers

expressionOut.description: The value of a string flag as text, or of a boolean flag as a Boolean, and the defaultValue of the endpoint as text when the flag is missing or is another type

language.description: The name of the language to use.

expression.description: The expression value in your chosen language syntax.

trim.label: advanced
trim.description: Whether to trim the source code to remove leading and trailing whitespaces and line breaks.

resolveResource.label: advanced
resolveResource.description: Whether a result of the expression that is a String starting with resource: is loaded as a resource and its content becomes the result, e.g. a script that returns resource:file:order.json or resource:classpath:templates/order.json (a name without a scheme is a classpath resource). Off by default; the resource: prefix on the expression text itself is always resolved. Applies to the expression used as a value, not as a predicate.
